title: Slow Down, Think Deeply
coreMove: Deep thought grows when you keep working while you wait: return to the evidence, ask the next question, and refuse the first answer when it has not earned trust.

exampleSpecs.stakes: whether a public claim about Leonardo's notebooks outruns the evidence
exampleSpecs.requiredBeat: A two-bad-options choice tests whether slowness is engagement or delay.

exampleSpecs.audience: research leads asked to compress a complicated finding
exampleSpecs.stakes: whether a public paragraph claims more support than the files hold
exampleSpecs.requiredBeat: Two people discover the lesson through what they are willing to say aloud.

exampleSpecs.audience: analysts who trust the freshest data
exampleSpecs.stakes: whether approval rests on an untested input
exampleSpecs.requiredBeat: The expected weak point is overturned by a slower evidence pass.

exampleSpecs.stakes: whether one striking image becomes a false map
exampleSpecs.requiredBeat: A compressed message thread lets the pause land between the lines.

exampleSpecs.stakes: whether a claim enters a grant before its support is tested
exampleSpecs.requiredBeat: A grant reviewer chooses whether to approve quickly or test the weakest evidence first.

exampleSpecs.audience: researchers learning to stay with details
exampleSpecs.stakes: whether a caption hardens before the page has been seen closely
exampleSpecs.requiredBeat: A small lived moment lets the observed detail carry the lesson.
